title: Sr. Test Analyst
description: Job Summary Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams. Responsibilities Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments. Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects. Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions. Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios. Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts. Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk. Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility. Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements. Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components. Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team. Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles. Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability. Qualifications Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations. Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments. Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively. Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness. Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions. Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting. Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

Its capabilities span registration, purchasing, badging and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. We work across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success and regional business teams to deliver reliable services, improve customer experiences and create measurable business value. About the Role We’re seeking a Business Analyst with a strong focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to bridge product delivery and business validation. You’ll coordinate testing, help business users evaluate new features, manage feedback, and communicate releases in clear, accessible language. The focus is hands-on business acceptance and coordination—not software development or test automation engineering. Responsibilities (What you’ll do) Plan and coordinate business acceptance testing Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to understand desired outcomes, user journeys, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Turn requirements into practical, risk-based UAT scenarios covering standard journeys, exceptions, and relevant regional variations. Coordinate testing scope and schedules, providing participants with clear instructions, test-event links, and prerequisites. Work with engineering, QA, and configuration teams to ensure environments, test data, and configurations are ready before testing. Perform hands-on business validation and help users investigate and reproduce unexpected results. Manage feedback, defects, and acceptance evidence Maintain a consolidated record of business feedback and communicate test completion, outstanding observations, and potential enhancements. Separate defects from configuration issues, clarification requests, and enhancement ideas, working with product and technical teams to agree next steps. Document reproducible issues, including expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and business impact, and coordinate retesting after fixes. Report progress, coverage, blockers, and residual risks so decision-makers can clearly assess readiness. Coordinate acceptance evidence and follow-up while keeping approval and validation accountability with the relevant Business Units. Support release communication and continuous improvement Prepare business-facing release updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant limitations or actions. Keep testing guidance, feedback records, and supporting documentation accessible to global stakeholders. Create reusable scenarios and checklists to improve consistency and reduce repeated effort across releases. Apply lessons from UAT and production issues to strengthen future acceptance coverage and identify gaps earlier. Collaborate across regions and time zones, keeping dependencies, decisions, and ownership clear. Requirements (What you’ll bring) Practical experience in UAT, business analysis, functional testing, or a similar role supporting user-facing digital products. Experience translating requirements and business processes into clear acceptance criteria and end-to-end test scenarios. Ability to organize testing with business users, balance competing priorities, and follow issues through to documented outcomes. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to explain business impact as well as technical symptoms. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing user guidance, test summaries, and release updates. Experience with issue-tracking and collaborative documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalents. Understanding of Agile delivery and the differences between engineering QA, business acceptance, and release approval. A collaborative approach and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a distributed team. Experience with test-management tools, basic data queries, or API-testing tools to support investigations. Defects and feedback are actionable, assigned, and followed through, with unresolved risks visible before release decisions. title: QA Analyst - Intern
description: Job Description: Intern: QA Analyst About Us: UpEnergy is the leading developer of anti-poverty climate impact projects in Africa. We accelerate decarbonization and while delivering long-term health and income benefits in local communities. We provide life-improving clean technologies and carbon reduction and capture projects that protect the local environment, deliver health benefits and cleaner air, and reduce poverty through financial savings and employment. Our project sustainably benefits and enables people to live better lives within more climate resilient communities. To date, UpEnergy has built over 95 emission reduction projects, impacted over 4 million lives, and reduced over 3 million tons of CO2 Emissions across 10 countries. All UpEnergy’s work is characterized by respect for the people we serve, rigorous measurement, deep local knowledge and established teams on the ground to ensure the highest impact and results. We do all this through our commitment to drive long-term business growth through technical innovation, close customer engagement and increased data-driven decision making. The UpEnergy team continues to grow, across multiple African countries, from 20 to over 170+ full time team members in the past two years, reflecting the growth of the company for which we now seek incredible, like-minded talent who are excited to join us in delivering even more impact. Learn more here: UpEnergy Group Why This Role As Carbon Data & QC Ops grows in scale and complexity — more markets, more monthly cycles, more deliverables going to field teams, leadership, auditors and registries — quality and consistency checks need a dedicated owner. This role builds that layer: a second pair of eyes across the team's output before it ships, so reliability doesn't depend on one person catching everything alone. The role starts high-level — general quality assurance across data, forms, reports and tools. As trust and familiarity build, scope naturally grows into broader day-to-day operational support. Role Summary Own quality assurance across the team's deliverables — data, forms, reports, dashboards, and working tools — catching errors early and keeping output reliable and consistent before it goes out. Key Responsibilities Quality review: check deliverables — data outputs, forms, reports, dashboards — for accuracy and consistency before they ship. Source verification: spot-check numbers and records against source data. Review logging: keep a simple, current log of what was checked and what was found — no review without a record. Early escalation: flag anything uncertain the same day rather than guess or sit on it. Day-to-day support: pick up broader operational and data tasks as capacity and trust grow — this role is designed to expand, not stay fixed. Candidate Profile Must-Haves High attention to detail; methodical and comfortable with repetitive, precision-dependent work. Clear written communication — much of the work is asynchronous review and reporting. Proactive problem-solver — surfaces issues with a proposed fix, not just a flag. Reliable and self-directed; this role runs on a checklist and a log, not close supervision. Nice-to-Haves (bonus, not gating) Familiarity with survey/data-collection tools (e.g. XLSForm, SurveyCTO, ODK, KoboToolbox). Basic SQL and/or Python — enough to spot-check a query or re-run a script and read its output. Prior exposure to carbon markets, M&E, or program data — shortens ramp-up, not required. Explicitly Not Required Not a developer hire — no new feature-building or software-engineering expected. No prior carbon-credit or MRV expertise required. What You'll Gain Direct, hands-on mentorship from the Senior Data Analyst on real carbon-market data and operations — not shadow work, actual production deliverables. Broad exposure across data, forms, reporting and tooling — a strong general foundation, not a narrow niche. Growing ownership — the role expands as trust builds, not a role capped at one task forever. A structured ramp-up with regular feedback, not thrown in blind. Decision Rights Tier What it covers Flags & logs — no ask needed Any discrepancy found during review, however small. title: Business Analyst II
description: Business Analyst II Are you a strategic planner and problem-solver? Are you looking to develop your Data Analyst career? About the Team: Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors into our events. Its capabilities span registration, purchasing, badging and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. We work across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success and regional business teams to deliver reliable services, improve customer experiences and create measurable business value. About the Role We’re seeking a Business Analyst with a strong focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to bridge product delivery and business validation. You’ll coordinate testing, help business users evaluate new features, manage feedback, and communicate releases in clear, accessible language. The focus is hands-on business acceptance and coordination—not software development or test automation engineering. Responsibilities (What you’ll do) Plan and coordinate business acceptance testing Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to understand desired outcomes, user journeys, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Turn requirements into practical, risk-based UAT scenarios covering standard journeys, exceptions, and relevant regional variations. Coordinate testing scope and schedules, providing participants with clear instructions, test-event links, and prerequisites. Work with engineering, QA, and configuration teams to ensure environments, test data, and configurations are ready before testing. Perform hands-on business validation and help users investigate and reproduce unexpected results. Manage feedback, defects, and acceptance evidence Maintain a consolidated record of business feedback and communicate test completion, outstanding observations, and potential enhancements. Separate defects from configuration issues, clarification requests, and enhancement ideas, working with product and technical teams to agree next steps. Document reproducible issues, including expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and business impact, and coordinate retesting after fixes. Report progress, coverage, blockers, and residual risks so decision-makers can clearly assess readiness. Coordinate acceptance evidence and follow-up while keeping approval and validation accountability with the relevant Business Units. Support release communication and continuous improvement Prepare business-facing release updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant limitations or actions. Keep testing guidance, feedback records, and supporting documentation accessible to global stakeholders. Create reusable scenarios and checklists to improve consistency and reduce repeated effort across releases. Apply lessons from UAT and production issues to strengthen future acceptance coverage and identify gaps earlier. Collaborate across regions and time zones, keeping dependencies, decisions, and ownership clear. Requirements (What you’ll bring) Practical experience in UAT, business analysis, functional testing, or a similar role supporting user-facing digital products. Experience translating requirements and business processes into clear acceptance criteria and end-to-end test scenarios. Ability to organize testing with business users, balance competing priorities, and follow issues through to documented outcomes. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to explain business impact as well as technical symptoms. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing user guidance, test summaries, and release updates. Experience with issue-tracking and collaborative documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalents. Understanding of Agile delivery and the differences between engineering QA, business acceptance, and release approval. A collaborative approach and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a distributed team. Useful, but not essential, skills Experience with event registration, ticketing, eCommerce, or other transaction-based customer journeys. Familiarity with payments, invoicing, discounts, upgrades, entitlements, or integrations between customer-facing and back-office systems. Exposure to onsite operational tools, badge management, or access-control workflows. Awareness of accessibility, localization, and data-quality considerations in business acceptance testing. Experience with test-management tools, basic data queries, or API-testing tools to support investigations. What success looks like Business users know what to test, how to participate, and where to provide feedback. Critical business journeys have clear acceptance coverage and traceable results. Defects and feedback are actionable, assigned, and followed through, with unresolved risks visible before release decisions. Business approvers receive concise evidence to support acceptance decisions. Release communications clearly explain changes and limitations, helping teams prepare for adoption. Reusable guidance and lessons learned make each testing cycle more effective. Why join us? Help shape digital experiences that connect online registration with the live event experience. You’ll work across product, technology, and business operations, building domain knowledge while improving how changes are validated and communicated. RX values collaboration, inclusion, curiosity, and learning, with opportunities to contribute across a global network. Work in a Way That Works for You We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous well-being initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working for You We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. description: QA Engineer Key Responsibilities Own whether the platform is safe to release - the automated suite, the manual passes automation cannot replace, and the judgement about what a failing test actually means Build and keep the end-to-end suite in Playwright across the journeys that matter - a patient booked, registered, seen, billed, dispensed to and reported on - and keep it fast and trustworthy enough that nobody is tempted to ignore a red build Write the test plan for each module from what the hospital does rather than from what the screen shows, with the Business Analyst and the module owner in the room Own the regression pack that runs before every release, and grow it every time something escapes Run beta: put each release in front of the hospitals own people on migrated data, log what they find so it can be reproduced, and close it before the next release starts Be the person who says a release is not ready, and be right often enough that it carries weight Where Testing Is Mandatory Money - every path that produces a bill, a discount, a refund or a day-end total, including the ones that fail halfway through Stock - batch, expiry, issue and return, and the concurrent case where two counters sell the last strip Clinical safety - allergy and interaction checks, dose limits by age and weight, critical values, and every alert that must reach a human Access - that one hospital cannot see anothers data, and that a role cannot do what it should not Integrations - a laboratory result from a real analyser, an image from a real modality, an ABHA created against the real sandbox; a mock proves the code, not the hospital Test the failure paths as seriously as the happy ones; the happy path is the one everybody already tried Beta, Parallel Run and Go-Live Turn the acceptance scripts into something the hospitals own staff can run and sign, on their own migrated data, in the beta environment Design the parallel run: what is entered in both systems, what is reconciled daily, and what "the numbers match" means for registrations, bills, collections, dispensing and reports Be on the floor through cutover and hypercare, where the real testing happens, and bring what you see back into the suite Own test data: realistic, safe, and reproducible, including the awkward records that break things - the duplicate patient, the expired batch, the refund after a partial payment Working With the Team Sit in on specification work early, because the cheapest defect is the one caught while the specification is still a paragraph Keep every defect described so that someone who was not there can reproduce it - steps, data, environment, what was expected, what happened Track what escaped and why, and bring it to the retrospective rather than to an individual Pair with engineers on the automated checks that live beside the code, so testing is not a gate at the end but a habit along the way Tech Stack Playwright TypeScript pytest Python FastAPI PostgreSQL SQL REST OpenAPI GitHub Actions Docker HL7 v2 FHIR ABDM We build in Python on FastAPI with React in front of it, on Amazon Web Services, and we test it with Playwright and pytest. That is what this role writes, runs and reads every day, and we would rather say it plainly at the top than have you find out in week one. What you will work in every day End-to-end testing - Playwright with TypeScript, against the real web application: journeys, fixtures, test data builders, and traces that say why a run failed API and service testing - pytest and pytest-asyncio against FastAPI services; the OpenAPI schema is the contract, and tests are written to it Database verification - PostgreSQL and SQL good enough to prove in the database what the screen claims, and to spot the migration that silently rounded a rupee Continuous integration - GitHub Actions; the suite runs on every pull request, and a red build blocks a merge Environments - Docker-based environments for development, beta and UAT, each with its own reproducible data set Performance - load testing at peak outpatient volume with k6 or Locust, and the judgement to know which number matters Integration test beds - HL7 v2 messages from analysers over MLLP, DICOM modality worklist and PACS, and the ABDM sandbox for ABHA creation and consent Defect and test management - a shared tracker visible to the hospital, with a published severity and response standard What we need you to have used in production Playwright, Cypress or Selenium on a system people depended on - writing maintainable tests, not recording brittle ones A programming language , enough to write helpers, fixtures and data builders; TypeScript or Python, and the other within the first month API testing at the service layer, and the sense to know which layer a case belongs at SQL to verify data directly, not only through the screen A CI pipeline your tests ran in, where a failure meant something to the team Good to have as well Healthcare, banking, insurance, or another domain where a wrong number is a real consequence Testing integrations with devices or external systems - an analyser, a payment gateway, a government API Test design beyond the checklist: boundaries, equivalence classes, state transitions, concurrency Accessibility and usability testing on screens used by people who did not choose the software Running a user acceptance test with non-technical staff, and getting it signed Security testing basics - role-based access, injection, the OWASP top ten - and reading a VAPT report What Youll Bring Three or more years in software quality with real ownership of automation, not only manual execution Have been the person who said a release was not ready, and can describe what you saw and what happened next Enough programming to be useful in a codebase: helpers, fixtures, test data, and the occasional fix to the thing you found Comfortable at the service layer and in the database, not only at the screen Can write a defect report that a developer reproduces first time, and a test plan that a module owner recognises as their own work Methodical about the awkward cases - the refund after a partial payment, the expired batch, the patient registered twice - because those are where a hospital gets hurt Willing to sit at a billing counter or beside a nurse for a shift and come back with the cases the specification missed Preferred: healthcare or another domain where correctness is auditable after the fact, and experience with a parallel run or a system cutover Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. final-semester students need college approval for a full-time internship • Solid Python: functions, classes, modules, virtual environments, error handling, and reading and writing JSON, XML and CSV • Working knowledge of data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design • Hands-on use of at least one of NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn or PyTorch • Basic familiarity with LLMs: you have called an LLM API or built a small project with one • Comfortable with Git and the Linux command line • Clear written and spoken English • At least one project (GitHub, academic or personal) you can walk us through in detail Nice to have • None of these are required; each one helps you ramp up faster on Tempero. • Built something with an LLM framework or SDK (for example LangChain, LlamaIndex or a model provider's SDK), embeddings or a vector database • Experience exposing Python code as a web API with FastAPI or Flask, and packaging it with Docker • Interest in automotive, ADAS or autonomous driving; title: Engineer - Virtualization
description: Job Summary Position Overview: As an Engineer - Compute Virtualization, you will join the engineering team responsible for building, supporting, and improving compute and virtualization capabilities. Approximately 6 months or more of apprenticeship, internship, training, or equivalent hands-on experience in infrastructure, software engineering, cloud, virtualization, or related technologies. What You Will Do Build practical knowledge of compute, server virtualization, and infrastructure through deployment, configuration, testing, and support. Troubleshoot Linux/Ubuntu, virtualization, networking, infrastructure, and application issues with guidance from experienced engineers. Gain hands-on experience with Ansible, infrastructure APIs, automation, and configuration management. Develop Go engineering practices, including Git, code reviews, testing, debugging, documentation, and design discussions. Use metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerts to monitor services and participate in production support. Document and share technical findings, procedures, troubleshooting steps, and lessons learned. Collaborate across teams, communicate progress and blockers, and take on increasingly complex responsibilities as skills grow. Technical Qualifications Server virtualization concepts and terminology, including virtual machines, hypervisors, hosts, clusters, CPU, memory, and resource allocation. Linux, preferably Ubuntu, including common commands and basic administration and troubleshooting. Fundamental compute, storage, and networking concepts, including IP addressing, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, load balancing, high availability, and persistent versus ephemeral compute. Git and basic software-development practices; exposure to at least one low level programming language. Go/Golang experience is an advantage, not a requirement. REST APIs; familiarity with gRPC is an advantage. Automation or configuration-management concepts; exposure to Ansible is preferred. Testing concepts such as unit, integration, and automated testing. Cloud infrastructure concepts and how compute resources are provisioned and managed. Container technologies such as Docker, containerd, or Kubernetes, and monitoring/logging tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, or the ELK stack, are advantages. What We Are Looking For Curiosity learning: You investigate how systems work, ask thoughtful questions, learn from experienced engineers, and apply feedback. Accountability: You take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate when blocked or when help is needed, follow through on commitments, and learn from mistakes. Teamwork: You collaborate respectfully with engineers and partner teams, share what you know, learn from others, and contribute where needed. Problem solving: You approach problems logically, gather evidence from logs, documentation, error messages, and system behavior, and break larger problems into manageable pieces. Communication: You communicate technical information clearly in written and verbal form, document what you learn, and openly share progress, questions, and blockers. Education Experience Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical/industry experience. title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from Agentic AI flow testing and RAG pipeline validation to AI safety, test automation , and performance & reliability engineering . You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines. Responsibilities Agentic AI Testing Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows. Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion). Test tool-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time. Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions. Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph). Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages. Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query. Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora. Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval. Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality. Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality. Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes. Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns. Test Automation Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation. Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation. Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data. Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes. Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions. Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks. AI Safety & Security Testing Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems. Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior. Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources. Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness. Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas. Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies. Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including: Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect) Insecure Output Handling Training Data Poisoning Insecure Plugin / Tool Design Sensitive Information Disclosure Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity. Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management. Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations. Performance & Reliability Testing Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services. Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response. Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure. Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions. Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation. Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency. Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task. Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates. Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems. Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures. Domain Knowledge Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG. Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents. Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers). Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization. Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards. Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents). Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements. Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos). Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus. Experience 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering. 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI. Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. title: Senior Database Engineer – SQL/NoSQL (Development & Architecture)
description: About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Database Engineer to take ownership of our database systems, including the development, architecture, optimization, administration, and maintenance of both SQL and NoSQL databases. This is a hands-on technical role combining the responsibilities of a Database Developer, Database Administrator, and Database Architect. The ideal candidate must be capable of designing complex, scalable database architectures from the ground up while also possessing strong programming skills to develop and optimize stored procedures, complex queries, functions, scripts, and other database components. You will work closely with software architects, backend developers, DevOps engineers, and project teams to ensure that our database systems are secure, reliable, highly available, and optimized for performance. Key Responsibilities 1. Database Architecture & Design Design and architect highly scalable, secure, and efficient SQL and NoSQL database solutions for complex enterprise applications. Evaluate project requirements and determine the most appropriate database technologies and architectural approaches. Design logical and physical data models, relational schemas, document structures, relationships, and indexing strategies. Define database architecture for high-volume transactional applications, distributed systems, and microservices. Implement database design principles including normalization, denormalization, partitioning, replication, and sharding where appropriate. Design solutions for high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and horizontal/vertical scaling. Establish database architecture standards, documentation, and best practices across projects. 2. Database Development & Programming Develop, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and database scripts. Write efficient T-SQL, PL/pgSQL, or equivalent database programming code. Develop database-level logic and data processing routines for complex application requirements. Implement efficient data retrieval, transformation, validation, and manipulation operations. Design and maintain database migration scripts, schema changes, and data correction utilities. Optimize existing database code for performance, maintainability, and reliability. Review database scripts and SQL code developed by other engineers. Troubleshoot complex database programming issues and resolve data inconsistencies. 3. SQL & NoSQL Database Expertise Work extensively with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Design, develop, and maintain NoSQL databases such as MongoDB and Amazon DynamoDB. Understand and apply SQL versus NoSQL architectural patterns based on application requirements. Implement appropriate indexing, query optimization, and data modeling strategies for both relational and non-relational databases. Design efficient document schemas, collections, partition keys, and data access patterns. Work with caching technologies such as Redis where applicable. Evaluate trade-offs involving transactions, consistency, availability, scalability, and performance. 4. Database Administration & Maintenance Manage and maintain existing production, staging, and development database environments. Proactively monitor database health, availability, performance, storage utilization, and resource consumption. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, locking issues, inefficient queries, and connection problems. Establish and maintain automated database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures. Perform database upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and routine health checks. Implement appropriate database security controls, encryption, access management, and audit logging. Ensure database integrity, consistency, reliability, and data protection. Conduct root cause analysis of database incidents and implement preventive measures. 5. Performance Optimization & Scalability Analyze execution plans, query performance, indexing strategies, and database resource utilization. Optimize database schemas, stored procedures, queries, and data access patterns for improved application performance. Design scalable solutions capable of handling high transaction volumes and increasing data workloads. Implement query optimization, connection pooling, replication, and partitioning strategies where appropriate. Perform database capacity planning and identify opportunities for infrastructure and cost optimization. Recommend architectural improvements to address emerging performance and scalability challenges. 6. Cloud Database Management & Automation Work with cloud-hosted and managed database services, particularly on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Manage services such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Azure SQL Database, or equivalent platforms. Develop automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies for database maintenance and operational tasks. Collaborate with DevOps engineers to implement automated database deployments and infrastructure improvements. Integrate database schema changes and migrations into CI/CD pipelines. Support database migration between on-premises, cloud-hosted, and managed database environments. 7. Technical Collaboration & Engineering Standards Collaborate with software architects, backend engineers, and technical leads during solution design and implementation. Participate in architecture discussions and recommend suitable database technologies and designs. Review database architecture and SQL/NoSQL implementations across projects. Define coding standards, database development guidelines, and performance optimization practices. Maintain documentation covering database structures, configurations, dependencies, and recovery procedures. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to software developers on database best practices. Take ownership of complex database-related technical challenges and drive them through resolution. Required Technical Skills Relational Databases (Mandatory) Strong production experience with at least one major relational database: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Expert-level SQL programming and query optimization. Advanced experience with stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and database scripts. Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, transactions, locking, concurrency, and performance tuning. Experience designing relational schemas for complex enterprise applications. NoSQL Databases (Mandatory) Hands-on production experience with at least one major NoSQL database, preferably MongoDB or DynamoDB. Strong understanding of NoSQL data modeling, query patterns, indexing, and scalability. Experience designing and optimizing NoSQL databases for real-world application requirements. Understanding of consistency models, partitioning, replication, and distributed data management. Database Architecture (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience independently designing database architectures for medium-to-large or complex applications. Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL architectural patterns. Experience with high-availability, replication, disaster recovery, and scalable database solutions. Ability to evaluate and recommend suitable database technologies based on functional and non-functional requirements. Experience with cloud-hosted database architecture. Database Operations (Mandatory) Production database administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Database backup and restoration, including recovery testing. Database security, role-based access control, and data integrity. Database performance monitoring and capacity planning. Safe production schema migrations and deployment practices. Programming & Automation Advanced SQL/T-SQL/PL/pgSQL or equivalent database programming skills. Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages. Experience with Git, version-controlled database scripts, and database deployment automation. Preferred Qualifications 7+ years of relevant professional experience in database engineering, development, architecture, or administration. Strong, verifiable production experience with both SQL and NoSQL technologies. Experience architecting database solutions for enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, or high-volume transactional systems. Experience working with .NET, Node.js, or other backend development ecosystems. Familiarity with microservices architecture, REST/GraphQL APIs, and distributed systems. Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP database services. Experience with database migration, modernization, and performance improvement initiatives. Familiarity with database observability tools and cloud monitoring services. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Key Competencies Strong architectural thinking combined with hands-on programming ability. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently own database-related technical decisions. Strong understanding of application performance and database dependencies. Ability to balance scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost. Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Proactive approach to identifying and preventing production database issues.
